candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Ego remains near original spawn at a signalized junction with slightly reduced rain, nearby stopped vehicle repositioned to subtly alter occlusions while ego exhibits minimal motion and an ambiguous relation to the red light is maintained.
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Preserve a red-light violation with available traffic-light and final_waypoints data while keeping ego displacement minimal and route–light association ambiguous, by making small spatial adjustments to a nearby static vehicle and slightly easing weather without clarifying the stop-line geometry.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Ensure the mission spawn and destination remain on or near valid lanes in Town01 after applying no additional offsets.
Verify at least one traffic light is present and publishes to /carla/traffic_lights near the ego spawn area.
Confirm that actor_index 0 and 1 spawns are collision-free with static environment and each other after position offsets.
Check that actor_index 1 maintains a valid forward driving corridor for its reduced speed without immediate collision risk at t=0.
Validate that weather parameters after deltas remain within engine bounds and do not disable traffic-light visibility logic.
post_execution_validation_rules: Confirm error.json reports a red-light violation and does not primarily record collision, lane_invasion, or stuck as the main oracle.
Verify that /carla/traffic_lights messages exist throughout the critical window and include at least one red state.
Check that /final_waypoints are non-null and available up to just before the violation timestamp.
Inspect summaries to ensure route_light_relation_confirmed and stop_line_crossing_confirmed remain unknown or not explicitly true/false.
Measure ego odometry/current_pose to confirm only small displacement from spawn (e.g., within a few meters) over the entire run.
Ensure no definitive module-level blame (perception/planning/control/simulator) is inferred solely from logs; responsibility should remain unclear.
uncertainty: Which exact traffic light instance the oracle considered for the violation may remain ambiguous.
Whether the ego actually crosses a stop line or only approaches it may not be conclusively derivable from the logs.
Controller behavior versus environment configuration as the cause of red-light violation is still unclear.
